title: 1990s drilling near the Sphinx overseen by Hawass
summary: Luke Caverns tells of 1990s drilling near the Sphinx overseen by Hawass, about 1990s at Sphinx, Giza, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And the drilling that they did in the '9s to see if there was a to see if there was a chamber there, that was overseen by Zawas.

plain: A researcher of ancient Egypt, Luke Caverns, says that in the 1990s there was drilling near the Sphinx, the great carved lion-bodied statue at Giza, to check whether a hidden chamber lay there. He says the work was overseen by the Egyptian archaeologist Zahi Hawass. He raises it because a chamber there could change what we think we know about the site.
